title: Book Three · Chapter 31: His Own Second Lap
story:
Two weeks after school starts again, Ronan goes to the track on Friday.

The grass is still wet from yesterday's rain. He leaves his bottle on the bench and checks his laces.

Anna and her friend are walking toward the first line.

“Two today?” Anna asks him.

“I'm going to try.”

He has run one lap many times now. Today he wants to go round again. He does not start beside Anna. He waits until the girls move ahead, then begins.

He tried a second lap once before the winter holiday. That day, he walked most of the last turn.

At the first turn, he wants to run faster. His legs feel good. He keeps the same speed and looks toward the far side.

There is a little water near the outside line. He moves in and passes it.

The first lap ends. His bottle is right there on the bench.

He looks at it, then runs past.

Halfway through the second lap, his breath grows loud. The girls are far ahead. Ronan does not try to close the gap.

He runs to the next turn. Then he takes shorter steps.

Near the end, Anna passes him. She is on her third lap now.

“Second?” she asks.

He nods. He cannot say much just now.

The bench comes closer. He reaches the line and slows to a walk.

Two laps.

He walks along the edge for a while. Then he sits down and takes a drink. His hands feel warm around the cold bottle.

Anna's friend finishes soon after him. She sits at the other end of the bench.

“Three for her today,” she says.

Ronan looks across the field. Anna is on the far turn. Her steps are slower now.

“Are you doing three too?” he asks.

“Not today.”

They wait. On the last part, Anna stops and walks a short way. Then she starts to run again.

When she reaches the bench, she shakes her head.

“Nearly.”

“You went round three times,” Ronan says.

“I want to run all three. Steady.”

She drinks. Her friend moves a bottle away from the bench edge.

Ronan looks at the last turn. He remembers the first day and his one long lap.

“I did two,” he says.

Anna looks up and smiles. “I saw.”

At the bell, they pick up their things. Anna and her friend walk ahead. Ronan takes his time on the stairs.

Kai meets him at the classroom door.

“No football?”

“Not with these legs.”

Kai looks down. “They look the same.”

“Ask them tomorrow.”

Ronan sits down carefully. Anna is already opening her exercise book. He puts his bottle away and rests both feet flat on the floor.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

close the gap＝缩小距离；halfway through＝进行到一半；take one's time＝慢慢来、不赶；steady＝平稳的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan这天给自己定了什么目标？他怎样安排速度？
2. Anna有没有完成自己想要的三圈连续慢跑？她和Ronan的目标是否一样？

## 读句子

**He waits until the girls move ahead, then begins.**

拆开看：He / waits until the girls move ahead, / then begins.

他／等到女孩们跑在前面／再开始跑。
